say:0:1631143001:1.text: You rest your fingers on the crystal. Light swirls within, rippling softly.
say:0:1631143001:1.source_cn: 你轻轻将指尖贴上水晶球，刹那间，幽光流转，球体深处泛起...
say:0:1631143001:1.male: You rest your fingers on the crystal. Light swirls within, rippling softly.
say:0:1631143001:1.female: You rest your fingers on the crystal. Light swirls within, rippling softly.

say:1:1631143002:1.text: A faint whisper echoes through your thoughts:
say:1:1631143002:1.source_cn: 恍惚间，一句朦胧的低语如潮水漫过意识，在你的脑海中轻轻回荡。
say:1:1631143002:1.male: A faint whisper echoes through your thoughts:
say:1:1631143002:1.female: A faint whisper echoes through your thoughts:

say:2:1631143003:1.text: A tide of darkness swells and churns. The Serene Lyceum, a guiding beacon of the magical realm, quivers beneath currents unseen. Light and shadow weave and clash in a silent struggle.
say:2:1631143003:1.source_cn: “黑暗如潮水般涌来，莱希拉姆，这座魔法界的灯塔，正被来...
